backups.title: Backups
backups.enable: Back this cluster up to object storage
backups.enableHelp: Turns on WAL archiving and lets you take backups with pgBackRest.
backups.endpointHelp: Full https URL, for example https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com. pgBackRest requires TLS.
backups.secretHelp: Name of a Secret in this namespace with keys access-key and secret-key. pglord never stores the keys themselves.
backups.restartNote: Turning backups on or off changes WAL archiving, which needs a cluster restart before it takes effect.
backups.disabled: No backup repository configured for this cluster.
backups.none: No backups yet. Take one to check the repository works.
backups.label: Backup
backups.noRestoreYet: Restoring from a backup is not available yet — take a pg_dump before anything irreversible.
backups.verifyTlsHelp: Leave on for real object storage. Turn off only if your endpoint uses a self-signed certificate.

workload.title: Placement and resources

antiAffinityHelp.preferred: Instances are spread across nodes when possible, and still schedule if only one node is available.
antiAffinityHelp.required: Instances never share a node. On a cluster with fewer nodes than instances, the extra instances stay pending.
antiAffinityHelp.disabled: Instances may share a node, so one node failure can take the whole cluster down.

workload.resourcesHelp: Quantities like 100m, 1, 256Mi or 2Gi. Leave blank to set no limit.
workload.reservedKey: '{{key}}' is reserved by pglord and cannot be used.

config.title: Configuration
config.pendingRestart: Some settings need a restart before they take effect.
config.restartWarning: Instances restart one at a time, standbys first and the primary last. Connections drop briefly as each instance comes back.

preflight.title: Cluster permissions
preflight.intro: What pglord is allowed to do in its namespace, as reported by the Kubernetes API server.
preflight.allGranted: All required permissions are granted in namespace {{namespace}}.
preflight.missing: {{count}} required permissions are missing in namespace {{namespace}}. Cluster management will fail until they are granted.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.name: Name
clusters.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Max 40 characters.
clusters.storageHelp: Size with unit, for example 1Gi or 500Mi.
clusters.deleteWarning: The cluster and all of its data volumes will be removed. This cannot be undone.
clusters.emptyHint: Create your first HA Postgres cluster to get started.

clusterDetail.scaleDownWarning: Removing instances deletes their data volumes.
clusterDetail.storageGrowOnly: Storage can only grow, and your StorageClass must allow volume expansion.
clusterDetail.switchoverWarning: The current primary steps down and this instance takes over writes. Connections through the read-write service drop briefly and reconnect.
